reason: Checked against experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P.log, out_full_Q.log, tools/train_coordhead.py and experiments/ext_x138/DIFF.md sec.4. The idea's numbers are right (Q vs none out-of-embryo: -8.1 % on 44b6, -7.7 % on 6bba), but they measure the wrong thing, and the value left after correcting that is below +0.002 and inside the 0.003 LB noise. (1) The score does not depend on the constant annotation-convention offset. GT enters only through 7 um per-timepoint matching, and the 7 um re-match counts move by <= 50 of 112k (0.04 %) for every head, including a head that is 0.6 um biased (P). Post-ILP relink, readmit, gap filler and DeepCenter use PRED-PRED relative positions, where a constant offset cancels. Debias and embryo balancing therefore fix an effect the score does not reward. The gate metric (fixed-pair mean distance) mixes that offset with the random error. (2) I split out the bias under an isotropic-Gaussian approximation (the scratchpad script bias.py, run on the log summaries). Change in the zero-mean error sigma vs 'none': on 44b6->6bba Q -3.5 %, P -3.4 %, public (in-embryo) -4.8 %; on 6bba->44b6 Q -8.8 %, P -9.6 %, public -12.8 %. Public is in-embryo on 44b6, and 44b6 is overlapping crops of one movie, so near in-sample. Debias does not change the random component (Q ~= P). Most of Q's '7.7 %' on 6bba is z-bias reduction (0.82 -> 0.43 um), which the score does not reward. On the independent-clip direction, the useful out-of-embryo gain is only ~3.5 %. (3) Only in-embryo (leak5, the pooled 5-fold cross-fit) does volume help a lot: Q -16.5 % vs public -6.2 %. Neither head is in-embryo on the hidden embryos. On unseen embryos, the random-error edge of v2 over public is plausibly -3..+3 % (a guess between the out-of-embryo and in-embryo numbers). (4) The value per % is small. Of the head's +0.007 on x138, ~+0.0026 is the node multiplier (final nodes -2.9 %, most of it on ONE dummy movie, 44b6_0b24845f -10.7 %; DIFF.md sec.4). That leaves ~+0.0044 for a ~5-6 % random-error cut, i.e. ~+0.0007 per 1 %. So v2 vs public = -0.002..+0.002 (central +0.0005), plus node-multiplier drift of +-0.001 in an unknown direction, because v2's in-sample mean shift (0.82 um) differs from public's (0.74 um). (5) The pre-registered gate cannot tell us whether v2 beats public on the test. Its 44b6->6bba REF trains on 10 overlapping crops of one movie, so it is volume-starved and nearly any all-video candidate passes 0.97xREF. The '>= 60 % per-video win rate' on 44b6 counts 71 correlated crops. The 7 um re-match criterion is flat noise (+-0.04 %). One LB probe (noise 0.003) cannot resolve a +0.0005 expectation either. The expected public gain is well below +0.002, and the transfer case rests on a component (the offset) the metric ignores.
fix_if_any: Re-gate on quantities the score actually consumes, and only then consider it as a free passenger in a final, not as its own probe. (a) Replace fixed-pair mean distance with offset-invariant precision on both embryo folds: per-pair error after subtracting each video's mean error, AND frame-to-frame displacement error on matched GT edges (pred disp - GT disp), which is what relink and readmit see. Require v2 <= 0.95 x REF and <= public on the 6bba direction (the independent-clip one). Treat 44b6 results as a single sample. (b) Drop --balance/--debias for the random part (they only move the mean). If kept, keep them only to hold the mean shift within 0.1 um of public, so node counts do not drift. (c) Before any slot: run the dummy 4-video kernel and require final node count within +-0.5 % of exp56 on EVERY dummy movie, so node-multiplier artefacts cannot pose as gains. (d) Stack it only on top of a change that already has its own evidence (e.g. riding in F2 with #35's insertion) and do not attribute LB deltas to it. Even repaired, the expected value is ~+0.001 public / ~+0.001 private.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0005 central, range -0.002..+0.002 (includes +-0.001 node-multiplier drift); below the 0.003 LB noise, cannot be confirmed with one probe
realistic_private_gain: 0..+0.0015 (guess). The 199-video volume helps the random error mainly in-embryo; private embryos are unseen, and the offset robustness v2 adds is not scored
